Private Function Say(o As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Size
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Bold
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Italic
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Underline
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Strikethrough
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Color
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.ColorIndex
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.FontStyle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Subscript
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Superscript
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Background
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.ThemeColor
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.TintAndShade
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.ThemeFont
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    Err.Clear
    Say = s
End Function

Public Function Reads(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ch As Object, s As String, o As Object, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    For i = 1 To wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Count
        Set ch = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(i).Chart
        s = s & "#" & i & "~"
        On Error Resume Next
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.ChartTitle.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.Legend.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.Axes(1).TickLabels.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.Axes(2).TickLabels.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.ChartArea.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.Axes(2).AxisTitle.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.Axes(1).AxisTitle.Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
        Set o = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font
        If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number & "~" Else s = s & Say(o) & "~"
        Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Reads = s
End Function
